category_title: Non-verbal students with moderate to severe cognitive impairments who respond to modified instrumentation and social reinforcement
minimal_context: Zack is transitioning to a circle formation with his peers in a fourth-grade inclusive music class.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Alright class, it is time to transition to our circle formation.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Walks toward the circle with a girl from the class, looking around at the other fourth graders as if waiting for his captive audience to say "Good job, Zack!")

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Keep walking to your spot in the circle.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stops walking and stretches his arms out, trying to hug the girl walking next to him.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Zack, no hug. Let's just walk.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (When the girl touches his outstretched arms to hold him back, he ducks under her arms and hugs her anyway.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Alright class, it is time to transition to our circle formation.

STUDENT: (Walks toward the circle with a girl from the class, looking around at the other fourth graders as if waiting for his captive audience to say "Good job, Zack!")

TUTOR: Keep walking to your spot in the circle.

STUDENT: (Stops walking and stretches his arms out, trying to hug the girl walking next to him.)

TUTOR: Zack, no hug. Let's just walk.

STUDENT: (When the girl touches his outstretched arms to hold him back, he ducks under her arms and hugs her anyway.)

challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Tried to hug her. She firmly said, “Zack, no hug” and touched his outstretched arms in a way that held him back. He hugged her anyway by ducking under her arms.

behavior_patterns.condition: Interacting with peers in both inclusive and self-contained music settings.
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Will do something again and again to hear that applause, or to get that “Good job, Zack!”
behavior_patterns.internal_state: Knows he has a captive audience with [the fourth-grade class] and they are so loving and encouraging
